verdict.rationale: Retell is a voice-agent platform, so noise suppression and audio filtering are a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents a noise-cancellation, background-noise, or audio-filtering setting. The closest item is transcription mode (interim vs. context-aware results, endpointing). That is a latency/accuracy trade-off, which is adjacent to this story and does not count as noise suppression.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enable noise suppression or audio filtering so the agent stays coherent on noisy real-world calls
